title: Cuba antes de 1959
goal: Read how pre-revolutionary Cuba combined a relatively high per-capita income with deep inequality, near-total US economic dependence, and Batista's unpopular dictatorship.
grammar: Lejos de + infinitivo: corregir una idea equivocada

items: State how Cuba's per-capita income compared to the rest of the region.
Explain what happened to rural workers employed by the sugar industry.
Describe how dependent Cuba's economy was on the United States.
Explain who governed Cuba after 1952 and how his regime operated.
Use lejos de + infinitive to correct a mistaken assumption before giving the real picture.
